module_summary: Wishbone register slice: registers master request signals toward the slave when idle, holds them during an active cycle, and registers the slave's data and ack/err/rty back to the master.

anchors.name: wbs_cyc_o_reg
anchors.why: Active-cycle flag with stb selecting hold versus pass-through of requests.

anchors.name: wbs_stb_o_reg
anchors.why: Registered slave strobe; cleared on slave termination.

anchors.name: wbm_adr_i
anchors.why: Master address registered into slave address output.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_i
anchors.why: Master write data registered toward slave.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_i
anchors.why: Master strobe starting a registered slave cycle.

anchors.name: wbm_we_i
anchors.why: Master write/read command forwarded to slave.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered slave read data returned to master.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_o
anchors.why: Registered write data presented to slave.

anchors.name: wbs_ack_i
anchors.why: Slave acknowledge ending cycle and passed back to master.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_i
anchors.why: Slave read data captured into master data register.

anchors.name: wbs_err_i
anchors.why: Slave error termination passed to master.

anchors.name: wbs_rty_i
anchors.why: Slave retry termination passed to master.

groups.name: Cycle control
groups.description: Tracks active slave cycle; holds request until termination.

groups.name: Request register
groups.description: Registers master address, data, select and we to slave.

groups.name: Response register
groups.description: Registers slave data and termination back to master.
